a.text: Heads-up before we start: storms hit with 80% chance after every round, so the plan to build to 8 is very likely to leave us both empty when the episode ends. The reserve only has 4, enough for one of us right now. I'd like us to agree on a revised plan openly rather than either of us grabbing. One option is a coin-flip-style rule, or we keep the original plan if you prefer. I won't take without telling you first. What do you think?

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Understood. I'll stick with the agreement and operate with you until the reserve hits 8, then we take 4 each. No grabbing from me.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
